title: Normal form of the specified cocone derived comparison
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, $X$ any scheme, and $E\subseteq H\subseteq\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ finite intermediate extensions. Use the coefficient ring objects of [def-sfb-derived-extend-subfield] and [def-sfb-derived-extend-to-qlbar]; $\Omega_X$ is the pullback of the condensed ring whose continuous sections have image in one finite subfield. Write $\varphi:E_X\to H_X$, $\psi:H_X\to\Omega_X$, $\kappa:E_X\to\Omega_X$ for the coefficient inclusions, with $\psi\varphi=\kappa$ as in [lem-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map-comp]. In the internal module categories put $A=\operatorname{Ext}_{\varphi}$, $B=\operatorname{Ext}_{\psi}$, $D=\operatorname{Ext}_{\psi\varphi}$ and $C=\operatorname{Ext}_{\kappa}$, using [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. Let $u:BA\xrightarrow{\sim}D$ be the unit-compatible comparison of their scalar-extension adjunctions with the canonically identified common right adjoint, as in [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation], and let $e:D\xrightarrow{\sim}C$ be the specified coefficient-map equality comparison of [def-sfb-extend-scalars-iso-of-eq].

Write $L$ for the total left derived functor of an exact additive functor, with its specified localization comparison [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], and let $c:L(BA)\xrightarrow{\sim}(LB)(LA)$ be the exact-derived composition comparison [lem-sfb-exact-derived-composition]. The fixed canonical cocone comparison $\delta$ constructed in [def-sfb-derived-extend-comp-iso] has the normal form
$$\delta=L(e\circ u)\circ c^{-1}:(LB)(LA)\xrightarrow{\sim}LC.$$
Here $L(e\circ u)$ denotes the induced natural isomorphism of [lem-sfb-exact-derived-natural-iso]. Under these identifications $LA=T_{E,H}$, $LB=T_{H,\Omega}$ and $LC=T_{E,\Omega}$ are the specified functors, with their object and arrow assignments; no additional automorphism of a derived functor is inserted. The equation concerns the specified construction, rather than an arbitrary isomorphism having the same endpoints.
